name: Snake
source: A 17 year old third year whose presence at the school baffles most, considering its prestige and exclusivity. She often skips class, flagrantly breaks school rules, rarely listens to authority, and has garnered a reputation that makes most fear to cross her path. She seems not to care about anyone at the school whatsoever.
